continuity: The three masked attackers were Nanman infiltrators whose tongues had been severed and healed long before the assault; all died after severing their own heart meridians.
Jin believes Dark Heaven knew about his possession of the Myriad-Poison Ring and used the attackers' self-destruction to eliminate the possibility of interrogation.
Sama Pyo survived the assault after losing blood, most of which belonged to the attackers; Taishan remains intensely protective of him.
The assault began less than half a shichen after Jin left the Fire Dragon Pavilion, and patrol warriors were also found dead.
Heugung and Yohi disappeared from the Nanman Beast Palace's Inner Palace before Yayul Mok arrived.
plot: Jin fails to stop three masked Peak masters from severing their own heart meridians. He briefly revives the last attacker through his Scorching Yang Qi, but discovers that all three are Nanman and had their tongues cut out long ago, making interrogation impossible. Jin and Namho conclude that Baeksang, Yohi, and Heugung all remain possible suspects, while Dark Heaven likely organized the attack to prevent the Myriad-Poison Ring from being recovered. Sama Pyo survives his fight with the attackers, and Taishan is relieved to learn that his Lord is safe. Yayul Mok then arrives and reports that the patrol warriors are dead and that Heugung and Yohi have disappeared from the Inner Palace.
translation_decisions: Use sever one's own heart meridian for 심맥을 끊다.

active_continuity: Jin remains in the Nanman Beast Palace's Inner Palace as the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and head of the Fire Dragon Pavilion.
Heugung alleges that Baeksang colluded with Dark Heaven, has secretly evaded Baeksang's surveillance for more than twenty years, and used the Bone-Shrinking Technique to meet Jin.
Heugung genuinely loves Yohi and had promised to cooperate with Jin before the assault on the Fire Dragon Pavilion.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion was attacked at night less than half a shichen after Jin left, and patrol warriors were also killed.
Three masked Peak masters attacked the pavilion; they were Nanman infiltrators with tongues severed long ago and died after severing their own heart meridians.
Jin could not identify the attack's organizer because the surviving infiltrator could not speak before dying.
Jin suspects Dark Heaven knew he possessed the Myriad-Poison Ring and arranged the attackers' self-destruction to prevent interrogation.
Baeksang, Yohi, and Heugung remain possible suspects, while Dark Heaven appears to be the broader force behind the assault.
Sama Pyo survived the attack, and Taishan remains fiercely protective of him.
Heugung and Yohi have disappeared from the Inner Palace.
Yayul Mok arrived after the attack and reported the dead patrol warriors and the disappearance of the two great chieftains.
open_questions: Who ordered the assault on the Fire Dragon Pavilion, and how was Dark Heaven involved?
Where are Heugung and Yohi, and were they involved in the attack or taken by its organizers?
Is Baeksang truly colluding with Dark Heaven, and what evidence can Heugung provide?
Will the Beast Miao King accept Heugung as a witness and guarantee Heugung's and Yohi's safety?
temporary_decisions: Use Dark Heaven hound for 암천의 주구.
